items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: caused Playmore to cancell out his other engagements

ctx.x: Yeah. And we played there. But it happened that this company had hired the -- had rented the hall and caused Playmore to cancell out his other engagements when they found the guy was bringing a black band in. It was too late to do anything about it, you know. So anyway, all we did was to come in the back door and go up there on that thing and play, you know.
How big a band was this, then?
